title: Dijkstra 5 cues + subtitles
prerequisite: Learner can read edge weights and track a running best distance.
success_check: Learner predicts dist(t) before the relax a-t cue runs, then compares with the shown update.

scenes.title: Track Dijkstra relaxations with subtitles
scenes.concept_target: Each relax keeps the smallest known dist; subtitles mark each distance update.

narration_cues.text: We track dist from source s. Relax means keep the shorter path. Dist of s is zero, others start at inf. Follow the subtitles as each cue updates a label.
visible_objects: graph nodes s a b t
narration_cues.change: Graph, edge weights, and initial dist labels appear; layout stays fixed for all cues.

narration_cues.text: Relax edge s to a with weight 4. The candidate is 0 plus 4. Dist of a becomes 4.
narration_cues.change: Edge s-a highlights and dist(a) updates from inf to 4.

narration_cues.text: Relax edge s to b with weight 2. The candidate beats inf. Dist of b becomes 2.
narration_cues.change: Edge s-b highlights and dist(b) updates from inf to 2.

narration_cues.text: Relax edge a to t with weight 3. From dist a equals 4, the candidate is 7. Dist of t becomes 7.
narration_cues.change: Edge a-t highlights and dist(t) updates from inf to 7.

narration_cues.text: Done. Dist values are s 0, a 4, b 2, t 7. Edge b to t would give 9, so dist t stays 7. The subtitles matched each relax cue. Predict the result before running, then compare.
narration_cues.change: Final distances hold with a one-line caption; no node moves.
